note: The music note the feedback asks for cannot fit on the monitor: a readable eighth note (ring head, stem, flag) is about 12x13 and needs 8 clearance to the screen edges (a 28x29 screen), but with the speaker cabinet beside the monitor the screen interior is at most about 10x8 inside 40x32. A dot-and-stem note merges into a hook, which is the rejected drawing.
